message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV labels and HDF5 files without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards beyond a single assert on colname length and a type assertion on the labels Series.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local files (CSV, HDF5) with no remote fetching, and no checksum verification or authentication is performed on any data source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only encodes labels with LabelEncoder and splits data; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline reads from CSV and HDF5 files and applies augmentation transforms, but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses ModelCheckpoint to save models and loads configurations from YAML files, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading pretrained weights or serialized models.

No detected label distribution validation: The code logs class names and uses a MinimumOccupancySampler for balancing, but there is no explicit validation of label distribution, class balance checks, or anomalous sample detection before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress-test routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/CV split is performed, there is no held-out test set isolated from training data, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metric sources to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on inference inputs; data is loaded directly from HDF5 and passed to the model without any sanitization checks.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validations applied to model outputs before they are returned or written to CSV.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
